name: codex
title: Codex / GPT cross-vendor interface
summary: Adds the OpenAI-backed half of the harness: cross-vendor code review through the Codex CLI, and the two-model /deep-plan planning roundabout through the OpenAI API.
notes: Windows: codex-command-runner.exe, codex-resources AND codex-windows-sandbox-setup.exe must sit DIRECTLY beside codex.exe. Codex resolves the sandbox helper by name, so a copy one directory down (inside codex-resources\) is never found — the sandbox is never set up and reviews return nothing while looking healthy. The self-check below finds that state and repairs it where it can.
Without this pack the harness still gets full fresh-context Opus review; it just has no cross-vendor option.
